name: Juice JuiceStaking unbounded stake multiplier
summary: JuiceStaking.stake() accepted any stakeWeek, and harvest() paid a bonus of pending × (stakeWeek − 1) × 9% with no cap. The attacker staked a little JUICE with stakeWeek 3,000,000,000, then called harvest() to pay out the contract's reward pool and stakers' JUICE as bonus, and sold it for ETH.
notes: The stake tx 0xaa14164b only bought and staked the attacker's own JUICE; value first left JuiceStaking in this harvest, which anchors. startStaking's reward funding and start time are a balance and a gate, not resets.
Campaign: the attacker's two further harvests and two copycats (stakeWeek 3e9 and 4e8) that harvested and sold in one tx each; no other harvest ever paid an outsized bonus.

JUICE had no DefiLlama price during the main drain: valued at the ETH the attacker realised selling it (five sells in refs), prorated to exclude the JUICE it bought itself; the copycat harvests use DefiLlama prices.
